title: add-rag-agent-quickstarts-and-docs-update
author: Samantha Park
description: Add a set of RAG templates, agents/tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates to make it easy for engineers to onboard RAG+agent patterns. Motivation: provide production-oriented examples that show how to wire Redwood's streaming, tool-calling, and RAG caching together for retrieval-augmented generation use cases. This PR includes templates for common retriever setups (vectorstore + metadata filters), an opinionated agent example showing function/tool calling with a search tool and a browser/tool sample, and docs site pages (quickstarts and sidebar) to surface these examples. Changes: - Add three RAG templates (bm25+faiss, dense-vectorstore, hybrid) and README explaining when to use each. - Add an agents/tool-calling quickstart containing: example agent loop, tool adapters for Search and Browser, typed responses, and tests. - Update docs site sidebar and quickstart pages to include the new guides and cross-links to SDK snippets. - Add small CSS tweak for code block widths on mobile. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Docs pages and navigation updates - [x] Basic unit tests for example components - [x] CI green and reviewers approved Related: Linear ENG-3412 (RAG templates & quickstarts), PM-789 (docs priority). See internal example harness at redwood-examples/agents/README.md for how to run locally. Notes on usage: the examples use the open-model aliases from redwood-model-registry and include a local docker-compose for the vectorstore test harness (FAISS). Conservatively scoped — no changes to runtime or infra configs.
